simple: An enterprise password manager for employees: a centralised encrypted vault (in the cloud or on your own infrastructure) with policies, a strong password generator, alerts about passwords that have appeared in leaks, and controlled sharing of work accounts without sending passwords over messengers. It also stores notes, files, tokens and keys; mobile access with offline mode, audit and reports are included. Useful for applications that do not support single sign-on (SSO). Licensed per user.
